short_description: See your Claude Code sessions at a glance and answer permission prompts with the bar's buttons.
description:
Your Claude Code sessions on the bar: who is working, who is done, and permission prompts you answer with the wheel and Start.

## Install

Connect the bar by USB, paste one line, then press Start on the bar when it shows Approve? Setup.

- **macOS**, in Terminal: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code/main/install.sh | bash
- **Windows**, in PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code/main/install.ps1 | iex

## Controls

- **Wheel**: moves through the sessions; on a permission prompt, picks Yes or No.
- **Start** or **wheel press**: opens a session; on a prompt, sends the answer.
- **Back**: returns to the list; on a prompt, hands it back to the terminal; from the list, closes the app.

## FAQ

Wrong token, a new computer or any other message on the bar: connect the cable and run the same line again. More in the [FAQ](https://github.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code#faq).
